editorial.blurb: This fast-casual Chinese spot defies expectations with genuinely fresh, flavorful food and service that actually cares—proof that speed and quality aren't mutually exclusive.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Orange Chicken and ask for double vegetables if you want more freshness; avoid the chow mein late in the evening when quality can slip, and aim for earlier hours when everything's at its peak.

topDishes.note: Consistently crispy, tangy, and perfectly balanced—a genuine comfort meal
